title: eu work further sanctions against russian individuals germany says 2026 09 02
text:
BERLIN, Sept 2 (Reuters) - German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul ​said on Wednesday that the ‌European Union will work on imposing further sanctions on Russian individuals in the ​coming weeks.
"The EU has ​imposed extensive sanctions on Russia, but ⁠we will certainly continue to ​work on imposing sanctions on individuals ​in the coming weeks," he said on the sidelines of an EU meeting in ​Ireland.
"Pressure on Russia is being ​stepped up and support for Ukraine also ‌remains ⁠at a high level. That is the unity we are demonstrating at this time," he said.
The top ​diplomat's comments ​come ⁠after the German government said on Tuesday that Russia was ​responsible for an attempted ​drone ⁠attack at Leipzig/Halle airport last month and that it ordered a series ⁠of ​measures in response.
